name: Kubernetes - Cluster
description: The Kubernetes - Cluster dashboard provides a detailed view of the cluster health, along with details on all the components and resources.
title: Kubernetes - Cluster

queries.queryString: cluster={{cluster}} metric=:kube_pod_info_node_count: | quantize 30s using max| sum | timeshift -2m
cluster={{cluster}}  metric=kube_node_status_condition condition=Ready status="true"| quantize 30s | sum by node | sum | timeshift -2m
cluster={{cluster}}   metric=kube_node_status_condition condition=Ready !status="true" | quantize 30s using max | sum | timeshift -2m
cluster={{cluster}} metric=kube_pod_status_phase phase=Running | quantize 30s | sum by cluster,pod | sum | timeshift -2m
cluster={{cluster}}  metric=kube_pod_status_phase phase=Failed| quantize 30s | sum by cluster,pod | sum | timeshift -2m
cluster={{cluster}}   metric=node:node_cpu_utilisation:avg1m  |avg |  eval _value*100 | eval round(_value)
metric=node:node_cpu_utilisation:avg1m cluster={{cluster}} | avg by node | topk(500,avg)
#B * 100 along node
metric=node:cluster_memory_utilisation:ratio cluster={{cluster}} | eval _value * 100 | sum by cluster | avg | eval round(_value)
metric=node:node_filesystem_usage: cluster={{cluster}} | eval _value * 100 |  avg | eval round(_value)
metric=node:node_net_utilisation:sum_irate cluster={{cluster}} | sum
metric=node:node_net_saturation:sum_irate cluster={{cluster}} | sum
metric=node:node_num_cpu:sum cluster={{cluster}} | sum
metric=node:node_memory_bytes_total:sum cluster={{cluster}} | eval _value / 1000000 | sum | eval round(_value) | timeshift -2m
metric=kube_pod_status_phase (phase=pending or phase=unknown or phase=failed)  cluster={{cluster}} |  sum
metric=kube_pod_status_phase (phase=pending or phase=unknown or phase=failed)  cluster={{cluster}} | sum by pod, namespace | filter sum > 0

*events* cluster={{cluster}}
| json field=_raw "object.reason" as reason
| json field=_raw "object.type"
| limit 100
| json field=_raw "object.involvedObject.kind" as kind nodrop
| count by reason, cluster, kind

panels.title: CPU Usage vs Allocatable vs Requests (Cores)

queries.queryString: cluster={{cluster}}  metric=kube_node_status_allocatable resource=cpu | quantize 1m |sum by cluster
cluster={{cluster}}  metric=kube_pod_container_resource_requests resource=cpu | quantize 1m |sum by cluster
cluster={{cluster}} metric=container_cpu_usage_seconds_total  | quantize 1m |rate | sum by cluster
#A as Allocatable
#B as Requests
#C as Usage

panels.title: Memory Allocatable vs Requests vs Usage (MB)

queries.queryString: cluster={{cluster}}  metric=kube_node_status_capacity resource=memory | quantize 1m | sum by cluster | eval _value  / (1000000)  | timeshift -2m
cluster={{cluster}}  metric=kube_pod_container_resource_requests resource=memory  | quantize 1m  | sum by cluster | eval _value  / (1000000) | timeshift -2m
cluster={{cluster}} metric=container_memory_working_set_bytes | quantize 1m | sum by cluster | eval _value / 1000000 | timeshift -2m
#A as Allocatable
#B as Requests
#C as  Usage
*events* cluster={{cluster}} | timeslice 1d| count by _timeslice

cluster={{cluster}}
| json  "log" as msg
| where !isNull(msg)
| count by cluster, node,pod,msg,_messageTime
| sort _messageTime desc
| limit 100
| fields - _messageTime, _count

cluster={{cluster}} (error or critical)
| json  "log" as msg
| where !isNull(msg)
| count by cluster, node,pod,msg,_messageTime
| sort _messageTime desc
| limit 100
| fields - _messageTime, _count
cluster={{cluster}} metric=kube_daemonset_status_current_number_scheduled  | quantize to 5m | max by cluster| sum
cluster={{cluster}} metric=kube_daemonset_status_current_number_scheduled | max by cluster
cluster={{cluster}} metric=kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled | max by cluster
cluster={{cluster}} metric=kube_statefulset_replicas    | quantize 1m |  max
cluster={{cluster}}  metric=kube_statefulset_status_replicas   | quantize 1m | max
metric=container_cpu_usage_seconds_total cluster={{cluster}} | count by cluster, namespace | sum by namespace | count
cluster={{cluster}}  metric=kube_statefulset_status_replicas  | max
metric=container_network_receive_bytes_total cluster={{cluster}} | quantize 1m | rate | sum by cluster | eval _value/1000000 | topk(500,max)
metric=container_network_transmit_bytes_total cluster={{cluster}} | quantize 1m | rate | sum by cluster | eval _value/1000000 | topk(500,max)
cluster={{cluster}}  metric=kube_pod_status_phase phase=Failed| quantize 30s | sum by cluster,pod | filter sum > 0 | timeshift -2m
_origin=kubernetes   cluster={{cluster}}  metric=kube_pod_container_status_ready | sum by pod, namespace | filter latest < 1 | count
_origin=kubernetes   cluster={{cluster}}  metric=kube_pod_container_status_ready | sum by pod, namespace | filter latest < 1
